final: WITH v AS (SELECT COALESCE(p.death_country,'') AS country, CAST(a.points_won AS REAL)/a.points_max AS ratio FROM player_award_vote a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE a.points_won IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max IS NOT NULL AND a.points_max <> 0), c AS (SELECT country, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM v GROUP BY country) SELECT country, avg_ratio, avg_ratio / (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) FROM c) AS ratio_to_mean FROM c
